🚨| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Hafiz Gariba is an option to bolster Barça's defense in La Liga, but he is NOT eligible to participate in the UCL as of now.

According to UEFA regulations, to qualify as a List B youth player, an individual must have been eligible to play for the club for an uninterrupted period of at least two years since their 15th birthday. Because Gariba only joined Barcelona's youth setup in February 2025, he has not yet completed the required 2 consecutive years of registration at the club.

Since he was not integrated into Barcelona's senior List A roster when registration closed, he cannot currently participate in the competition. He has to wait at least until the January UCL registration window opens. #fcblive
